caption: The video showcases two round brilliant-cut faceted gemstones side by side on a white, textured surface with horizontal ridges and two circular recesses along the top edge. Both stones stay fixed, facet patterns unrotated and the top kite facets pointing upward, never touching. The play of light across their faces changes continuously: bright white flashes and small orange, blue and violet reflections shift in position and intensity. The right stone throws a strong vertical lens-flare beam upward toward the recess above it, its starburst swelling and dimming as a blue-violet chevron of fire appears at intervals. The left stone's highlights drift around its face, pairing an orange flash at the upper-left with a white flash at the upper-right. The brilliance cycles through bright and subdued states.
relations: Two fixed gemstones on ridged surface -> continuous shifting of bright flashes and colored reflections across facets.
Right stone orientation -> vertical lens-flare beam and blue-violet chevron of fire swell and dim.
Left stone orientation -> highlights drift, pairing orange flash at upper-left with white at upper-right.
Ambient lighting -> brilliance cycles through bright and subdued states while stones remain unrotated.
